title: HumanMetadata
description: Metadata shape for contentType 'human'. Identity attributes stored in ContentView.metadata.

agencyStage.description: Current agency stage: visitor | observer | participant | steward | elder

profileReach.description: How visible this profile is (maps to protocol reach levels)

affinities.description: Content domains this human has demonstrated affinity with

externalIdentifiers.description: External identity links (email, DID, social handles). Key is provider, value is identifier.
